featured_reviews.name: Umesh Gawas
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have an emotional attachment to this place. This is a favourite place for me and my girlfriend (now wife) to hangout after office.
It's a special place because this is where I proposed my wife and began our "happily ever after".
Now coming to actual review.
My friend once said (may be even jokingly) that MM is the best restaurant in Mumbai.
And I would like to confirm it definitely deserves the title of "The Best".
It has the best bombil fry I ever had (and that too available whole year round).
I usually have following things:
1) Bombil Fry
2) Tangdi Kebab
3) Mutton Tawa Pulav
4) Neer Dosa with Dal Fry (Not usual but our fav).
I don't think any restaurant has Neer Dosa done so good available here and with great pricing.
The ambience may not be the best but good enough for me.
I just hope that this place lives on for eternity.
Maybe I'm being biased here but highly recommended place for sea food and alcohol.

The dumplings were delicate and flavorful, the stir-fried dishes were vibrant and crisp, and the house special fried rice was rich without being heavy. You can truly taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into preparation.

What stood out just as much as the food was the service. The staff were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu, offering excellent recommendations and ensuring everything was perfect throughout the meal.

Portions were generous, prices were fair, and the overall experience exceeded expectations. Whether you’re looking for a cozy dinner, a family gathering spot, or a place to impress guests, this restaurant delivers on all levels.

Highly recommended — I’ll definitely be coming back!

Do not go to this restaurant by seeing the ambience.
I would rather give minus stars for this resturant but that option is not available.

We ordered
1. Cheese pakoda
2. Masala pineapple mocktail
3. Summer delight mocktail
I have never ever eaten such a pathetic cheese pakoda. Literally it was a cheese cube dipped in batter and fried in oil.
Masala pineapple tasted like masala water.
Summer delight was also not up to the mark.

After tasting this we skipped our plan for having lunch over there and went to another place.
They take forever to bring ur order and after such a long wait they serve such a pathetic thing and on top of that the cost is so high.

featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're a fan of North Indian cuisine, V V Restaurant and Bar is a must-visit! Located in a cozy spot, this restaurant  a delightful dining experience with its tasty food, excellent service....

The star of the menu is undoubtedly their Cocktail Biryani. This dish is a flavorful mix of chicken, mutton, and prawns — a perfect treat for biryani lovers! The combination of different meats makes it stand out, and the flavors are simply mouthwatering.

We also tried their Tikka, which was another highlight of our meal. The tikka was perfectly cooked, juicy, and seasoned to perfection. What impressed us the most was the unique way it was served — a creative presentation that made the experience even more enjoyable.

The staff was friendly and attentive, and the service was quick. Whether you're visiting with friends or family, V V Restaurant and Bar is a great place to relax and enjoy some delicious North Indian delicacies.

Highly recommended for biryani lovers and tikka enthusiasts!

This women-run café serves soul-satisfying homestyle snacks with a Maharashtrian touch. The aloo paratha was generously stuffed and perfectly spiced, served hot with curd and pickle. Idli fry was crisp outside, soft inside, and packed with flavor. The masala Maggi had the perfect kick — comforting and nostalgic. Each dish felt like it was made with love, just like at home. A must-visit spot for fresh, hearty food made by passionate hands.
